blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Converge prevented Rain or Shine from completing another come-from-behind and sneaked out a 130-125 victory to tie their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series at 1-1 on Friday at Ninoy Aquino Stadium. Mikey Williams’ three-point shot gave the FiberXers the timely cushion and made the Elasto Painters pay for two turnovers courtesy from Adrian Nocum to draw level in the best-of-five affair. Williams’ three-pointer gave Converge a 127-123 lead with 35 seconds left, a big boost for the former Finals Most Valuable Player whose numbers and minutes have been inconsistent.
